question: ¿Qué sponsor de la industria, contando solo al sponsor principal de cada ensayo, tiene más ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados) que prueban fármacos que actúan sobre algún gen de la familia ERBB (EGFR, ERBB2, ERBB3 o ERBB4)?

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.sponsors sp
JOIN linking.sponsor ls ON ls.name = sp.name AND ls.industry
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = sp.nct_id
WHERE sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead'
  AND s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_drug td
    JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
    JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
    WHERE td.nct_id = s.nct_id AND tg.gene_symbol IN ('EGFR','ERBB2','ERBB3','ERBB4')
  )
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
